PrincipalTitle: Tiendline | Custom Software Development in Argentina
meta-og-title: Tiendline | Custom Software Development in Argentina
meta-description: Argentine software development company. We build websites, applications and custom systems for businesses in Argentina and abroad.
meta-og-description: Websites, applications and custom systems for businesses. Software development with direct communication from Argentina.
hero-title: Custom software development for businesses ready to grow.
short-introduction: Tiendline is an Argentine software development company. We design and build websites, applications and custom systems that streamline operations, improve your business and support growth.
hero-trust: Based in Argentina · Local and international clients · Direct communication
services-title: Software development for every stage of your business.
services-description: From a corporate website to an internal platform, we build technology around the way your team actually works, focused on concrete results.
service-web-description: Institutional sites, landing pages and portals that are fast, accessible and ready for search engines.
service-custom-description: Management systems, dashboards and tools designed around your company's processes.
service-apps-description: Platforms with users, roles, payments and integrations, built to operate and scale.
service-digital-description: We review processes, identify manual work and turn it into measurable digital workflows.
service-integrations-description: We connect APIs, payment gateways, messaging and existing systems to avoid duplicated work.
service-support-description: Maintenance, improvements and monitoring after launch, with direct support.
products-description: We also build our own tools for specific operational needs.
products-product-title: Tiendline Event POS — Order and concession system for events and clubs
products-intro: An all-in-one web platform to manage sales, concessions, buffets and bars at tournaments, sporting events and festivals without queues or delays. Each organization runs on its own dedicated subdomain (your-club.tiendline.com).
product-qr-title: QR self-ordering from any phone (/cliente):
product-qr-description: Attendees scan the QR, build their order and pay online (Mercado Pago) or at the counter without queuing.
product-pos-title: Fast checkout and order numbers (/caja):
product-pos-description: A quick point of sale with 4-digit pickup codes, cash/digital control and ESC/POS thermal printing.
product-kitchen-description: A real-time preparation queue to dispatch orders without mistakes or paper tickets.
product-admin-description: Manage catalog, pricing, stock, staff and live sales reports.
about-description-1: Tiendline is an Argentine software development company. We work with businesses in Argentina and abroad to build websites, applications and systems that solve real operational and growth problems.
about-description-2: We get involved in the process, not just the code: we understand how your team works, set priorities and deliver maintainable, documented solutions ready to evolve.
work-process-title: A clear process, from idea to launch.
work-process-description: Six stages with defined scope, deliveries and direct communication at every step.
process-1-description: We understand the business, the users and the problem that needs solving.
process-2-description: We define features, priorities, timelines and a clear proposal.
process-3-description: We design the experience and validate the flow before writing code.
process-4-description: We build in stages, with reviewable deliveries and direct communication.
process-5-description: We test on real devices, fix issues and prepare the launch.
process-6-description: We ship, monitor and support the product as it evolves.
pricing-plans-description: Simple plans for corporate websites. Choose a starting point and we'll tailor the scope together.
pricing-note: Plans are a starting point for websites. If you need custom software, let's talk about your project.
projects-description: Websites and platforms for businesses that needed a clear, effective digital presence.
project-desde-description: A news website from Entre Ríos, with content publishing and fast reading on every device.
project-crespo-description: Corporate website for a concrete company, with product information and commercial contact.
project-club-description: Corporate website for a country club: offering, facilities and contact.
talk-to-us-description: Tell us what you need to solve. We'll reply on WhatsApp to understand the scope and suggest a concrete next step.
footer-tagline: Argentine software development company. Websites, applications and custom systems.
error-description: The page you're looking for doesn't exist or has moved. Let's get you back on track.
